name: Guangzhou Municipal People's Government (Guangzhou SASAC)
via: city-level government of Guangzhou, Guangdong, China; its State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Guangzhou SASAC) exercises the state's ownership rights in the city's state-owned enterprises
note: Guangzhou SASAC holds 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group, which holds 54.02% of GAC Group, per GAC Group's 2025 annual report control-chain diagram.
